title: Drop Us A Line - Is This Andy's Last 'Drop Us A Line'?
content:
Dan, James and Andy sift through the correspondence sent in by listeners.

Don't forget our LIVE Drop Us A Line is still available to stream on catch-up: nosuchthingasafish.com/live

If you'd like to write in, you can email podcast@qi.com

Edited by Leying Lee, Joe Mayo and Dan Schreiber

Team includes Tara Dorrell and Ethan Ruparelia
